Software Engineer - Backend & Full Stack
Company: CloudScale Technologies
Location: Remote / New York, NY
Experience: 0-2 years (New Graduates welcome)

About the Role:
We are seeking a talented Software Engineer to join our core backend platform team. You will build resilient, distributed RESTful microservices, optimize database queries, and design real-time data pipelines.

Key Responsibilities:
- Design, implement, and maintain high-performance REST APIs and microservices in Node.js and Express.
- Work closely with MongoDB and Redis caching layers to ensure low-latency data access.
- Implement robust unit, integration, and end-to-end tests to maintain high code reliability.
- Collaborate with frontend engineers to integrate responsive client interfaces.
- Participate in architectural reviews, incident response, and performance profiling.

Required Technical Skills:
- JavaScript / TypeScript proficiency (ES6+ standards)
- Backend development experience with Node.js and Express.js
- Database design and optimization with MongoDB or PostgreSQL
- RESTful API design principles and authentication mechanisms (JWT / Sessions)
- Version control using Git and collaborative workflows

Preferred Qualifications:
- Familiarity with Redis in-memory caching and caching strategies
- Basic understanding of Docker containerization and CI/CD pipelines
- Knowledge of Data Structures, Algorithms, and System Design fundamentals
- Exposure to Vector Databases (ChromaDB) or LLM application development
